reasoning: The question asks about week-over-week change in US commercial and industrial loans (TOTCI) from March 15 to March 22, 2026. Evidence shows US banks had record profits in 2025, strong loan growth ($750B added to portfolios totaling $13.5T), and the Fed's Senior Loan Officer Survey indicates banks expect stronger commercial loan demand in 2026 with no further tightening expected. Historical TOTCI data typically shows small weekly fluctuations. Given the positive lending environment and expected demand growth, a slight increase is more likely than a decrease, though weekly changes can go either direction.
